statement: The source method changed from an Exeter City Council Local List HTML/register page to Devon County Council HER's geometry-native Local List polygon Feature Layer 10. Official layer metadata verifies polygon geometry plus Name/ListEntry fields, but the distinct Exeter first-50 feature query payload was not retrievable and direct network resolution failed before any feature was read. Source-area/service metadata is retained without parcel/building progress credit; no geometry or record was inferred.
